explanation.surface: The weather grows more blustery, and someone grows bolder as the hours pass.
explanation.walkthrough: T is time; in GUSTIER it moves one place forward, ahead of S. 'Windier' also hints at flatulence, which 'gutsier' fits.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with guts has courage, so a gutsier person shows more nerve and daring.

clue.text: One snooker shot secures quiet stalemate

parts.note: the Roman numeral

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast, so one piece is gripped inside another

parts.note: a massé is a sharply swerving cue shot
p is piano, quiet in music

explanation.surface: A single cue shot quietly locks up the frame in a deadlock.
explanation.walkthrough: A massé is struck with a near-vertical cue to make the ball curve; snooker players also lay snookers to force stalemates.
explanation.definitionFit: An impasse is a deadlock in which no progress is possible, like stalemate in chess.

clue.text: Small spray of flowers, a number out of season

indicators.note: taking something out of a word removes it from inside

parts.note: spring is one of the four seasons
N stands for an unspecified number in maths

explanation.surface: A florist sells small bunches of blooms not in season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of season' reads as unavailable at this time of year, but 'out of' is the removal and season is the source word.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprig is a small stem bearing leaves or blossoms, cut from a plant for decoration.

clue.text: Record relating to part of the digestive system

parts.note: to enter data is to record it
on means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A medical record concerns a section of someone's gut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relating to' looks like a link phrase, but it supplies ON, as in a talk on a subject.
explanation.definitionFit: The enteron is the alimentary canal, the whole gut from mouth to anus in anatomy.

clue.text: After exercise they dread becoming dry

indicators.note: after being exercised, letters have been put through their paces and moved about

parts.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: After a workout, people fear getting thirsty.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is a fitness warning, apt since exercise does dry you out.
explanation.definitionFit: To dehydrate is to lose water or remove it, which is to dry out.
